title: Bounded-below flat representatives over the integers
statement: For every $K\in D^+(\mathbf Z)$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories] there is a cochain complex $P^\bullet$ of abelian groups, with $P^i=0$ for all $i<b$ for some integer $b$, and an isomorphism $Q(P^\bullet)\cong K$ in $D(\mathbf Z)$. Every $P^i$ is flat over $\mathbf Z$, meaning that $-\otimes_{\mathbf Z}P^i$ preserves short exact sequences of abelian groups. Here $Q$ is localization at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Tag 0F0E (lemma-pull-out-constant), first model-construction paragraph; Tag 0653 (more-algebra, lemma-last-one-flat), flatness of the truncation term

proof.text: By [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], choose an integer $a$ such that $K$ belongs to $D(\mathbf Z)^{\ge a}$. The representing-complex equivalence in [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category] supplies a complex $C^\bullet$ of abelian groups with $C^n=0$ for $n<a$ and an isomorphism $Q(C^\bullet)\cong K$. We construct a flat complex mapping quasi-isomorphically to this $C^\bullet$.

source.place: Tag 0F0E (lemma-pull-out-constant), first model-construction paragraph; explicit elementary construction written here

proof.text: For every integer $n$, let $A_n$ be the free integer module on the nonzero elements of $C^n$, implemented by finitely supported integer functions on that subtype. Let $e_n:A_n\to C^n$ be evaluation. Zero lifts to zero and every nonzero $c$ lifts to the singleton generator with coefficient $1$, so $e_n$ is surjective. If $C^n=0$, the generator subtype is empty, so $A_n=0$. Each $A_n$ is free and hence flat and torsion free. This uniformly implements the degreewise free construction without a conditional definition at the lower bound.

source.place: Tag 0F0E (lemma-pull-out-constant), first model-construction paragraph; explicit elementary construction written here

proof.text: Define $F^n=A_n\oplus A_{n-1}$, with $d_F^n(x,y)=(0,x)$ and $q^n(x,y)=e_n(x)+d_C^{n-1}e_{n-1}(y)$. The Lean definitions coverD, cover and coverπ construct these data; coverD_sq and coverπF_comm prove the differential-square and chain-map equations, including transport across $(n+1)-1=n$. The equation for $q$ follows from $d_C^2=0$. Each $q^n$ is surjective by lifting into its first summand. If $n<a$, both free summands are zero, hence $F^n=0$. Each $F^n$ is free, hence flat and torsion free.

source.place: Tag 0F0E (lemma-pull-out-constant), first model-construction paragraph; explicit elementary construction written here

proof.text: Take the categorical kernel $G=\ker(q)$ and its inclusion $i:G\to F$. The surjectivity in every degree makes $q$ an epimorphism of complexes, so $G\xrightarrow{i}F\xrightarrow{q}C$ is short exact, using ShortComplex.exact_kernel. Set $P=\operatorname{Cone}(i)$ using Mathlib CochainComplex.mappingCone. Its term in degree $n$ is canonically isomorphic to $G^{n+1}\oplus F^n$. For $n<a-1$, $F^n$ and $F^{n+1}$ are zero; the monomorphism $G^{n+1}\to F^{n+1}$ then implies $G^{n+1}=0$. Thus $P^n=0$.

source.place: Tag 0F0E (lemma-pull-out-constant), first model-construction paragraph; explicit elementary construction written here

proof.text: The canonical cone map $p:P\to C$ is CochainComplex.mappingCone.descShortComplex applied to the kernel short complex. Mathlib CochainComplex.mappingCone.quasiIso_descShortComplex proves that it is a quasi-isomorphism because that short complex is short exact. This is the existing categorical implementation of the cycle-lifting and boundary-lifting argument in the original steps 5 and 6; no new intermediate theorem is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0F0E (lemma-pull-out-constant), first model-construction paragraph; explicit elementary construction written here

proof.text: Each $G^n$ embeds into the torsion-free $F^n$, so it is torsion free by Function.Injective.moduleIsTorsionFree. Products of two torsion-free modules are torsion free by applying injectivity of scalar multiplication to their two coordinates. Transfer this property to $P^n$ through the cone-term isomorphism $P^n\cong G^{n+1}\oplus F^n$ and ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-pid-torsion-free-module-flat], implemented by Module.Flat.flat_iff_torsion_eq_bot_of_isBezout and Submodule.isTorsionFree_iff_torsion_eq_bot, to the integers. Thus every $P^n$ is flat. The requested statement already uses Module.Flat, so no additional tensor-exactness proof is necessary.

source.place: Tag 0AUW (lemma-dedekind-torsion-free-flat), part (1), with the explicit subgroup and direct-sum checks above

proof.text: Localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] inverts the quasi-isomorphism $p:P\to C$. Compose the resulting isomorphism $Q(P)\cong Q(C)$ with the inverse of the step-1 isomorphism $K\cong Q(C)$. The complex $P$, lower bound $b=a-1$, degreewise flatness, and this derived isomorphism prove all clauses without any remaining sorry.
